question: When do Annex III high-risk AI system obligations become applicable?

By what date must AI systems classified as high-risk under Article 6(1) and Annex I (i.e. safety components of products already covered by other EU product-safety legislation) comply with the AI Act's high-risk requirements?
What was the original application date for the AI Act's high-risk system requirements (Chapter III), before the Digital Omnibus amendment?
When do the new prohibited AI practices added by the Digital Omnibus (the new points (ba) and (bb) inserted into Article 5(1), and new paragraphs 5(1a) and 5(1b)) become applicable?
Does the Digital Omnibus change when Chapters I and II of the AI Act apply?
According to the Digital Omnibus amendment, from what date do Articles 102 to 110 of the AI Act apply?
According to the AI Act's definitions in Article 3, what does 'reasonably foreseeable misuse' mean?
Under Article 5 of the AI Act, is real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement completely banned?
Under Article 6(3) of the AI Act, can an AI system listed in Annex III avoid being classified as high-risk?
Under Article 9 of the AI Act, is the risk management system for a high-risk AI system a one-time exercise done before market placement?
Under Article 10 of the AI Act, can a provider of a high-risk AI system ever process special categories of personal data (e.g. race, health data) to detect and correct bias?
Under Article 11 of the AI Act, do small and medium-sized enterprises get any relief from the technical documentation requirements for high-risk AI systems?
Under Article 12 of the AI Act, what minimum logging information must a high-risk remote biometric identification system record?
Under Article 13 of the AI Act, what must the instructions for use of a high-risk AI system contain regarding accuracy?
Under Article 14 of the AI Act, for high-risk remote biometric identification systems used for identification (Annex III point 1(a)), how many people must verify a match before a deployer acts on it?
Under Article 15 of the AI Act, what specific cybersecurity threats must high-risk AI systems' technical solutions address, where appropriate?

Under Article 16 of the AI Act, besides ensuring compliance with the Section 2 requirements, what conformity-related steps must a provider of a high-risk AI system complete before placing it on the market?
Under Article 50 of the AI Act, if an AI-generated deepfake forms part of an evidently satirical or artistic work, is the deployer still required to disclose that the content is AI-generated?
Under Article 53 of the AI Act, are providers of open-source general-purpose AI models exempt from all obligations in Article 53(1)?
Under Article 55 of the AI Act, name two obligations that apply specifically to providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk, beyond the base Article 53 obligations.

Under Article 113 of the AI Act's original text, when do Chapter III Section 4 (notified bodies), Chapter V (GPAI models), Chapter VII (governance) and Chapter XII (penalties, excluding Article 101) become applicable?

According to the GPAI Code of Practice's Transparency Chapter, how long must Signatories retain previous versions of their Model Documentation after a general-purpose AI model has been placed on the market?

According to the GPAI Code of Practice's Transparency Chapter, within how many days of a downstream provider's request must a Signatory normally provide the additional information needed to integrate the model?

According to the GPAI Code of Practice's Copyright Chapter, what must Signatories do about websites that courts or public authorities in the EU/EEA have recognised as persistently and repeatedly infringing copyright on a commercial scale?

According to the GPAI Code of Practice's Copyright Chapter, how are Signatories expected to identify and comply with rights reservations expressed by rightsholders under Article 4(3) of the Copyright in the Digital Single Market Directive (2019/790) when web-crawling?
According to the Safety and Security Chapter of the GPAI Code of Practice, how often must Signatories conduct a Framework assessment of their Safety and Security Framework, at minimum?
According to the Safety and Security Chapter of the GPAI Code of Practice, how quickly must Signatories give the AI Office access to their Safety and Security Framework after it is confirmed?
According to the Commission's GPAI scope guidelines, what FLOP threshold creates a presumption that a general-purpose AI model has systemic risk?
According to the Commission's Article 50 transparency guidelines, is it sufficient for a provider to disclose that a chatbot is AI-powered only in its terms and conditions?

According to the Commission's Article 50 transparency guidelines, does a machine-readable watermark on an AI-generated image satisfy the Article 50(1) obligation to inform a person they are interacting with an AI system?
According to the (second draft) Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content, why do the drafters say a single active marking technique is not enough to meet Article 50(2)'s requirements?

If a company builds an AI-powered CV-screening tool that processes candidates' employment history and health-related disability accommodation notes to shortlist applicants, would this system trigger GDPR obligations in addition to the AI Act?
Does GDPR give a data subject any rights specifically about being subject to a fully automated hiring or credit-scoring decision made by an AI system?
Does deploying a high-risk AI system that does systematic, large-scale profiling of individuals require a GDPR Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA), separately from any AI Act obligations?

If an AI system used in recruitment processed special categories of personal data (e.g. data revealing racial or ethnic origin) to detect and correct algorithmic bias, is this permitted under GDPR on its own, or does something else need to apply?

Article 5(1)(h) of the AI Act prohibits real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement except in narrow cases. How does this provision interact with GDPR's rules on biometric data processing?

The AI Act Service Desk's summary of Article 113 says the Regulation 'shall apply from 2 August 2026', with earlier dates for certain chapters. Does the AI Act's own primary regulatory text (not just the Service Desk summary) confirm this same set of staggered dates?

Article 53(1)(d) of the AI Act requires GPAI providers to publish a training-data-content summary 'according to a template provided by the AI Office.' Does the GPAI Code of Practice's Transparency Chapter clarify how this training-content-summary obligation relates to the more detailed Model Documentation Signatories must keep?

The AI Act Service Desk's Article 53 page mentions that open-source GPAI providers are exempt from Article 53(1)(a) and (b) unless the model has systemic risk. Where in the primary AI Act regulation text is this exception actually written, and does it match the Service Desk's summary?

The Commission's GPAI scope guidelines describe an open-source exemption from Article 53(1)(a)-(b). Which article of the AI Act's own text, as also captured in the Service Desk's Article 53 page, establishes this exemption, and what condition removes it?

A provider wants to know whether their chatbot needs both an Article 50(1) 'you are talking to an AI' disclosure and a GDPR Article 13/14 information notice. Do these two obligations serve the same purpose, or are they distinct requirements that could both apply to the same system?
